column3: vyāptacarācarabhāvaviśeṣaṁ cinmayam ekam anantam bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṁ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi |
tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṁ bhāti mama tvaṁ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṁ mama |
svātmani viśvagaye tvayi nāthe tena na satsv api durdharaduḥkhavimohatrāsavidhāyiṣu |
antaka māṁ prati mā dṛśam enaṁ krodhakarālatamāṁ śaṅkarasevanacintanadhīro bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo .smi |
ittham mṛtyuyamāntakakarmapiśācair nātha namo .stu na jātu |
śaṅkara satyam idaṁ vratadānasnānatapo bhavatāpavidāri tāvakaśāstraparāmṛtacintā syandati cetasi nirvṛtidhārām ||
nṛtyati gāyati hṛṣyati gāḍhaṁ saṁvid iyaṁ mama tvāṁ priyam āpya sudarśanam ekam durlabham |
vasurasapauṣe kṛṣṇadaśamyām abhinavaguptaḥ stavam yena vibhur bhavamarusantāpaṁ śamayati janasya jhaṭiti |
